note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded ridge above the caves near Olive Hill, about 10 minutes off I-64; long rows of back-in sites with a full-hookup loop at the east end and a primitive tent loop at the west. Separate eight-site horse camp on the trail system (equestrian sites booked by phone). Cave tours, Smoky Valley Lake, lodge and restaurant in the park. --Claude
